statement.notes: Currency inferred as EUR from '€ million' in statement. 'Sales revenue' mapped to 'revenue'. 'Total operating cost' calculated as sum of 'Cost of sales', 'Distribution expenses', 'Administrative expenses', 'Other operating expenses', minus 'Other operating income' (as it is income, it reduces total cost). 'Earnings after tax' mapped to 'net income'. 'Income tax income/expense' mapped to 'taxes'. 'Interest expenses' taken directly. All values in millions as per source.
